title: Data Governance Request Concordance and SLA Orchestration
creator: Amira Patel
description: Purpose: Define a single, repeatable decision framework (concordance) and SLA orchestration layer for customer non-bug data-governance requests: logging redaction, retention changes, PII handling requests, and audit/export requests. Scope excludes software defects; it includes product configuration, policy changes, and controlled data-handling features. Goals: (1) reduce time-to-resolution for high-impact enterprise governance requests, (2) make decisions auditable and consistent across CS/SE/Legal/PM/Security, (3) provide clear SLOs and escalation paths, (4) surface required artifacts and security gating up-front to avoid scope creep.
acceptance_criteria: A documented concordance matrix that maps request types to decision outcomes and required approvals (legal/security/infra)
SLA tiers and SLOs defined and published (e.g., 48h initial response for high-impact, 10-business-day resolution target for low-complexity changes)
An intake checklist surfaced in support portal and SE intake templates so inbound requests include required artifacts 80% of the time
A routing and escalation playbook that assigns ownership (PM, Security, Infra) based on risk & regulatory mapping
A monitoring dashboard that tracks request aging, cycle time, approvals, and customer communications
steps: 1) Intake channel: Support ticket flagged as 'governance' OR SE/sales intake form OR Legal/Compliance email
2) Automated triage: parse request type tags (redaction|retention|PII|audit-export) and collect required artifacts (PII sample, retention window target, regulatory citation)
3) Risk & scope scoring: run checklist to compute risk_score (RegulatoryExposure, DataSensitivity, TechnicalEffort, CustomerCriticality) and customer_impact_score
4) Route to track: low-risk -> Config change track (PM+SRE), medium -> SRE+Security review, high -> Security+Legal+PM executive review
5) Define outcome options: Approve (config + deploy), Approve-with-mitigation (feature + compensating controls), Defer (workaround + timeline), Deny (with rationale and next steps)
6) SLA orchestration: set response and resolution SLOs per tier; automated reminders and escalation if missed
7) Post-decision: publish change request to audit log, notify customer, create rollout/monitoring plan, schedule a 30-day regression review
decision_matrix: Numeric thresholds: risk_score >= 8 => high (requires Security+Legal signoff), 5-7 => medium (Security review + PM approval), <=4 => low (PM + SRE). Customer_impact_score >7 elevates priority one tier. Regulatory tags (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2) force legal engagement regardless of numeric score.
artifacts_required: If redaction: example log lines + desired redaction regex or schema
If audit export: fields requested, recipients and transport security requirements
Business justification and list of affected customers/accounts
metrics: % requests with complete artifacts at intake
Post-change incidents attributed to governance changes
